description: Rust UI ecosystem on crates.io — Leptos, Dioxus, Yew. This descriptor covers Rust as a UI framework; for a project targeting web AND mobile native, use the `dioxus` descriptor, which is the sanctioned choice (Leptos and Yew are web-only). It is NOT where Mzizi's Rust shared core lives: the WASM harness, the N5 resilience state machine and the N4 safety gates are logic compiled to WASM behind framework-specific shells, not component source. Do not answer a core-logic question with this row.
name: Rust crates (Leptos/Dioxus/Yew)
tier_note: Rust UI ecosystem; dioxus is the sanctioned member.
